findings.title: Login-cache invalidation uses the org-wrapped IdP model
findings.body: update() loads the pre-update provider with getById(), which, when the organization feature is on, returns a wrapper whose isEnabled() is false whenever the organization is missing, disabled, or the organization provider is disabled — even if the stored IdP is enabled. registerIDPLoginInvalidationOnUpdate() then treats that wrapper as “not a login IdP”. getForLogin() fills its cache from the delegate query, which only checks the IdP’s own enabled/linkOnly/hideOnLogin/public flags, so that IdP can already be in the cached id set. If the update also makes the raw model ineligible (disable it, set hideOnLogin or linkOnly, or clear kc.org.broker.public) while the organization id is unchanged, both predicate checks fail and the login caches are left untouched. After the organization is enabled again, getById() returns the updated model (the per-IdP cache was invalidated) but the stale id is still in the login list. OrganizationAwareIdentityProviderBean only re-checks isEnabled(), so a hidden, link-only, or non-public broker is rendered on the login page, and any other getForLogin() caller is handed providers that no longer match the method contract. Decide eligibility from the unwrapped delegate model (idpDelegate.getById), not from the organization-aware wrapper.

findings.title: Login-cache test cleanup deletes the wrong IdP alias
findings.body: testCacheIDPForLogin registers cleanup as identityProviders().get("alias")::remove both in the loop that creates idp-alias-0..19 (line 381) and again for idp-alias-20 (line 425). Nothing removes the aliases that were actually created. On a shared test realm, those brokers remain after the test; the DELETE of the non-existent alias "alias" can also fail cleanup. Later cases in this class, including this test’s own exact cache sizes (5/10/6/11), then see extra login providers and become order-dependent. Register cleanup with the alias just created (and the same mistake at the pre-existing line 303 should be fixed the same way).
